radius.$description: The system radius. Locked — does not nest, never scales with size (AGENTS.md rule 5).

radius-chip.$description: The chip shape — a shape, not a size, and not part of the radius scale (AGENTS.md rule 5, docs/prd.md §8.4). Full circle (Tailwind's built-in rounded-full, not a token) is reserved for marks that hold no layout.
